newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI cuts interest cap on deposits up to 1 yr.
newsitem.headline: India RBI cuts interest cap on deposits up to 1 yr.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India on Tuesday cut the interest cap on deposits upto one year to nine percent from the current 10 percent in its monetary policy for the first six months of 1997/98 (April-March).
The new rate is effective April 16, 1997, and is applicable to only fresh deposits or renewal of maturing deposits.
Banks' freedom to fix their own interest rates on maturities over one year remain, the RBI said.
